purpose.summary: ZFAM002 is the primary 'Basic Mode' program for zFAM (z/OS File Access Manager), a CICS-based RESTful file access service. It handles HTTP-style POST, GET, PUT, and DELETE operations against VSAM/RLS key and file stores, supporting text (XML, JSON) and binary (GIF, JPEG, PDF, video) records up to 2GB. It manages features such as TTL, LOB handling, key generation with modulo, replication, and range-based deletes.

notable_features: USAGE POINTER for dynamic address management (GETMAIN)
COMP-3 fields for packed decimal arithmetic
Named Counter Server usage for unique key/modulo generation
VSAM/RLS and Coupling Facility Data Table (CFDT) support
HTTP header parsing (Content-Type, zFAM-TTL, zFAM-LOB, zFAM-Append, zFAM-UID, zFAM-Modulo, zFAM-RangeBegin, zFAM-RangeEnd, zFAM-ECR)
LINK to multiple sub-programs (ZFAM003, ZFAM004, ZFAM005, ZFAM007, ZFAM008, ZFAM009, ZFAM011, ZFAM031, ZFAM041, ZFAM090)
Large record support (text up to 3.2MB, binary up to 2GB)
